theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ (ρ : Euclid n → ℝ) (C : ℝ), Continuous ρ ∧ (∀ z, 0 ≤ ρ z) ∧ (∀ z : Euclid n, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → ρ z = 0) ∧ ∫ z, ρ z = 1 ∧ (∀ z, |ρ z| ≤ C) ∧ ∀ z z', |ρ z - ρ z'| ≤ C * ‖z - z'‖
